## Summary

Go backend engineer owning the full delivery cycle: system architecture, REST/gRPC APIs, database optimization, observability, releases, and 24/7 production support. Previously built city-wide emergency alerting systems and founded a subscription VPN service.

## Experience

### Wildberries — Golang Software Engineer (2024 – Present)
Design and delivery of high-load services for e-commerce and supply-chain operations. Full release cycle and production support across 7 projects.
- ClickHouse analytics: 10B+ rows, ~1 TB dataset, API response <= 300 ms.
- Optimized a 350 GB PostgreSQL table with recurring deadlocks.
- Designed and built 2 high-load services from scratch, including complex business logic.
- Built REST and gRPC APIs, RBAC, and WebSocket notifications for an employee support platform.
- Rolled out Jaeger and Pyroscope; built Grafana dashboards and CSAT, RSA, and SLA metrics.
- Led PostgreSQL-to-ClickHouse migrations and integrated a proprietary LLM into an employee support chat.
- Stack: Go, PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Kafka, gRPC.

### NorkinVPN — Founder & Backend Engineer (2024 – 2025)
Founded a subscription VPN service and grew it to ~200 paying customers across 3 servers handling ~4.5 TB of daily traffic.
- Owned backend engineering, infrastructure, subscription payments, customer support, and operations.
- Stack: VLESS, 3x-ui, Linux Infrastructure.

### Safe Region — Backend Developer (2022 – 2024)
Developed the core alerting stack for city-wide notification systems: synchronous alerts, SIP terminal grouping, and a modular VoIP integration layer.
- Built core alerting services with Go and Node.js.
- Configured test and production environments; introduced TDD, unit, and e2e tests.
- Stack: Go, Node.js, PostgreSQL, MongoDB.
